def padd7909 (f : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, x => x
  | k+1, x => padd7909 f k (f x)
theorem padd7909_add (f : Nat → Nat) (a b x : Nat) : padd7909 f (a + b) x = padd7909 f b (padd7909 f a x) :=
A: by
  induction a generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [padd7909]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [show k + 1 + b = (k + b) + 1 by omega]
    simp only [padd7909]
    exact ih (f x)

  | n+1, m => plus5858 n m + 1

theorem plus5858_zero_right (n : Nat) : plus5858 n 0 = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [plus5858, ih]

theorem plus5858_succ_right (n m : Nat) : plus5858 n (m+1) = plus5858 n m + 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [plus5858, ih]
theorem plus5858_comm (n m : Nat) : plus5858 n m = plus5858 m n :=
A: by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [plus5858, plus5858_zero_right]
  | succ k ih => simp [plus5858, ih, plus5858_succ_right]
